answers.explanation: CPU cycles, main memory, file storage, and I/O devices are the usual examples.
Accounting records usage, for billing or for statistics.
Authentication defends the system from outsiders, which is security.
Protection controls all access to system resources by processes and users inside the system.
The slides list it explicitly: security extends to defending external I/O devices.
It's the opposite: it matters when multiple users or jobs run at the same time.
Usage statistics are exactly what accounting is for.
